g.text: From open evening to first practice
Newcomers at our open evenings find a clear, no-pressure next step
into a first practice session, so interest turns into sustained…
Nobody feels recruited or pressured · Organisers' hours stay as they…
What actually happened? Report what you did and what you observed, with
numbers and the period if you have them.
Newcomers at a first practice within 3 weeks (sign-up
sheet): now 2 of 30, aiming for 8 of 30 by 30
End each open evening with one clear invitation: the
date of a first practice, what it asks of you, and
that no is a fine answer.
6 of 30 newcomers come to a first practice within 3
Stop if anyone tells us they felt pushed.
Thursday 16 October: I give the invitation in the
last ten minutes and hand out a card with the date
.g. Read on 4 of 7 nights, about 12 pages each time
